summary.intent: Land a series of fixes in the callisto repo: finish the version-write fidelity PR (#457) and then fix the E320 object-id alignment check in the release version commit verifier so it compares every directory of every package.
summary.outcome: PR #457 was retitled/updated and linked to a new trail. The E320 fix was implemented on branch fix/e320-object-id-alignment with tests merged into the existing test module (11 version_commit tests pass), a changeset added, clippy run, then committed and pushed. The PR for E320 was drafted but its creation and the trail link output were not confirmed in the transcript.

repo: Release version commit logic lives in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/version_commit.rs and has a single existing test module; new tests should be merged there rather than adding a second #[cfg(test)] module.
Changes require a changeset file in .changeset/ (e.g. e320-pair-alignment.md) alongside the code change.
Branches are created from origin/main with --no-track and pushed with -u; PR bodies are written to files and passed via --body-file.
Pre-commit hygiene in this repo includes cargo fmt and cargo clippy -p callisto-graph --all-targets -- -D warnings.

code.finding: E320 check used `.all()` semantics that only compared some directories; fix changes it to compare every directory of every package via a pair-alignment helper.

workflow: A unit test on an extracted helper does not guard the call site; reverting the call to `.all()` would not fail it, so a test that drives the real two-directory case is needed.
`rg -c` returning exit code 1 simply means zero matches, which was used to confirm the extra test module was removed.
Using python3 -I scripts in a tmp dir for scripted file edits, followed by cargo fmt and targeted cargo test, keeps edit-verify cycles tight.
`entire trail link <id> --json` is used to associate work with a trail.

friction: Initial helper-only tests did not actually protect the call site and had to be reworked into the existing test module.
Several chained commands with `| tail -1` hide most output, making failures in commit/push/trail steps hard to confirm.
open_items: The registry verifier also has an issue the assistant said it would act on next.
Confirm the E320 PR was actually opened using the drafted pr-e320.md body and that the trail link (#198) succeeded.
Verify a test exists that fails if the E320 call site reverts to `.all()`.
